- Creation of a GraphQL interface that implements the ontology
- Improvement to ingestion pipeline to use NATS as a PubSub queue
- CollectSub service that helps to allow GUAC to dynamically collect more data sources
- Improvements to collectors and ingestors to support new formats such as SLSA 1.0, Deps.dev, scorecards, etc.
